messages:
elena: Heads-up—found a partner-uploaded archive that contains a base64 KMS-wrapped blob under partner_payload.encrypted_blob. looks like they forwarded raw ingestion logs to our archive bucket.
elena: redacted sample: `CiQA7Y...==` - appears to be KMS ciphertext (starts with expected prefix).
taylor: which partner & pipeline? need blast radius and whether their SA had access to plaintext.
elena: partner: tidebridge-integration, pipeline: partner-ingest-gcs -> log-forwarder job. object path: gs://archive-bucket/partner-dumps/2026-03-20/abc.gz
samir: assume compromise until proven otherwise. quick plan: 1) ask partner to stop forwarding and delete object + proof 2) rotate any creds that could be in blob 3) decrypt in a locked environment to classify 4) tighten KMS/Vault RBAC 5) capture audit logs.
oncall: incident created INC-2026, paging sec oncall and partner contacts. (reacted :rotating_light:)
vault-bot: INC-2026 linked, sensitive-data handling checklist attached.
taylor: request partner produce GCS deletion audit entry or signed S3 delete receipt. also flip gating rule to block decrypts from the log-forwarder SA until we assess.
elena: messaged partner legal +sec. they claim no plaintext store but will cooperate. asked for object id, deletion proof, and ephemeral rotation schedule.
oncall: temporarily suspended the log-forwarder service account keys for ingest-project. will re-enable post-rotation.
samir: steps I'm about to run (ops commands):
```
# find KMS decrypt calls in the last 24h
gcloud logging read "resource.type=kms_key AND protoPayload.methodName:google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt" --freshness=1d
# find access to archive bucket objects
gcloud logging read "resource.type=gcs_bucket AND protoPayload.resourceName:projects/_/buckets/archive-bucket/objects/partner-dumps" --limit=100
```
(taylor: copied to INC-2026)
taylor: policy changes: remove decrypt permission from log-forwarder SA on our customer-wrap key, enable conditional deny where feasible, and add short-term monitoring alerts for any attempt.
elena: decryption plan: samir to run unwrap on a short-lived isolated VM with no egress, MFA for approve, take SHA256 of plaintext, paste classification summary (no secrets) here. approver: @taylor
samir: ack. I'll provision a locked runner, import KMS key (via IAM-binding only), decrypt, produce a small metadata summary (e.g., JSON keys present, top-level key names), record SHA256, then shred VM. ETA ~90m.
oncall: RBAC follow-up: rolling IAM policy now to revoke roles/*/cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt for log-forwarder SA. monitoring for fallout.
taylor: also enable Vault audit streaming for the last 7 days into sec-retention and grep for partner identity.
elena: timeline/owner notes:
- T+00:00 discovered blob, opened INC-2026 (elena)
- T+00:12 asked partner to delete + provide proof (elena)
- T+00:15 suspended log-forwarder SA (oncall)
- T+01:30 samir to complete decrypt and checksum (samir)
- T+03:00 rotate internal wrap keys & rewrap affected objects (infra)
- T+24:00 postmortem + RBAC policy rollouts (sec)
elena: please update INC-2026 at each step. i'll own partner comms and legal coordination. :white_check_mark:
vault-bot: rewrap job queued pending manual run after verification.
samir: starting decryption now in isolated env, will post non-secret summary and SHA256 when done.
